items.name: Summer in Bishkek 2024
items.information:
Русский
Summer in Bishkek 2024 - это открытый чемпионат по скоростной сборке головоломок в городе Бишкек.
Базовый регистрационный взнос за 1 дисциплину составляет 200 сом. За 2 или более дисциплин взнос составляет 700 сом.
Данные соревнования организованы при поддержки команды QBERS.
10 процетов от всех собранных средств будут отправлены в международную благотворительную организацию "Интеракт"

Кыргызча
Summer in Bishkek 2024 — Бишкек шаарында өтүүчү пазлдарды жогорку ылдамдыкта чогултуу боюнча ачык чемпионат.
1 дисциплинага негизги каттоо төлөмү 200 сом. 2 же андан көп дисциплиналар үчүн төлөм 700 сомду түзөт.
Бул мелдештер QBERS командасынын колдоосу менен уюштурулууда.
Бардык чогултулган каражаттардын 10 пайызы "Интеракт" эл аралык кайрымдуулук уюмуна жөнөтүлөт

English
Summer in Bishkek 2024 is an open championship in high-speed puzzle assembly in the city of Bishkek.
The basic registration fee for 1 discipline is 200 soms. For 2 or more disciplines the fee is 700 soms.
These competitions are organized with the support of the QBERS team.
10 percent of all funds raised will be sent to the international charity organization "Interact"

items.name: Oslo Open 2024
items.information:
## Informasjon

Norsk:

Velkommen til Oslo Open 2024!
Alle er velkommen, enten du løser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minutter. Du trenger heller ingen tidligere erfaring med kubekonkurranser. 
Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). 

Deltakeravgiften inkluderer lunsj på lørdag og søndag og snacks fredag kveld. 
Det blir salgsstand med salg av Oslo Open T-shirts og Nordicube selger kuber og stæsj.
Lokalet har kiosk med salg av snacks, mat og drikke og T-shirt workshop der deltakere og besøkende kan trykke sin egen T-shirt.

Velkommen til en helg i Oslo med ulike aktiviteter for kubeinteresserte!

Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take-away-tilbud i nærområdet.

Hvis du er medlem i Norges Kubeforbund får du 50 kr tilbake. Alle betaler først full påmeldingsavgift og så refunderer vi 50 kr til medlemmer av NKF. Klikk her for informasjon om[ medlemskap i NKF](https://kubing.no/OmOss). 

## Information

English:

Welcome to Oslo Open 2024!
Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior cube competition experience.
You need to register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up).

The participation fee includes lunch on Saturday and Sunday, as well as snacks on Friday evening. 
There will be a sales booth offering Oslo Open T-shirts and Nordicube selling cubes and accessories.
The venue also has a kiosk selling snacks, food, and drinks, and a T-shirt workshop where participants and visitors can print their own T-shirt.

Welcome to a weekend in Oslo with various activities for cube enthusiasts!

There are several shops in the area selling food and take-away. 

If you are a member of Norges Kubeforbund we will refund 50 NOK. Everyone pays full price at first, and we will refund 50 NOK to members. For NKF membership, please visit [NKF's website kubing.no](https://kubing.no/OmOss)

# ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaGxIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e1a87d9563999f890af638f98836b63b2aac90c5/6u.png) Español 

Hay un límite de 40 competidores para el registro.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AltavistaOtonal2024#44503-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AltavistaOtonal2024#44504-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación de la categoría, de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del Reglamento de la WCA.
* Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia.

Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA.

***
# ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaHBIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bacb00caed7d0c9177dc3ea7d687667b270ce30d/6i.png) English 

Competitor limit: 40.

* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AltavistaOtonal2024#44503-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AltavistaOtonal2024#44504-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Competitors must bring their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.
* It is important to read all the information available in the competition website.

Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

items.name: Trondheim Friends 2024
items.information:
## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Trondheim Friends 2024! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.
 
### On The Spot Registreringer
Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimFriends2024/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen.
 
### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimFriends2024#44248-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors).
 
---
 
## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to Trondheim Friends 2024! The competition is open to all who wish to compete.
 
### On The Spot Registration
Competitors may register on the spot for this competition. We strongly advise all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimFriends2024/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot.
 
### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimFriends2024#44248-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors) tab.

Inscrição de competidor: R$ 50,00
**Por se tratar de um local com tamanho limitado, será permitido apenas um convidado por competidor, sem a possibilidade de adição de novos convidados** 
Limite de competidores: 40
​
​
Registration fee: R$ 50,00
**As the venue has a limited size, it will be permitted a single guest per competitor, without any possibility of the addition of other guests.**
Competitor limit: 40
​
​
REGISTRO
A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos, sem o cumprimento destes, a inscrição não será aceita:
​
Estar familiarizado com o Regulamento da WCA;
Se inscrever através do site da WCA, realizar o pagamento de forma antecipada e mandar o comprovante para o organizador através do e-mail (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) indicando o nome completo do participante. Detalhes sobre o pagamento da inscrição abaixo.
​
Aguardar até que o registro eletrônico seja aceito. Caso não participe mesmo com o pagamento, não haverá devolução do dinheiro. 
Há um limite de 40 competidores
Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com).
​
Para os competidores menores de idade que forem ficar desacompanhados durante o período da noite, será necessário o envio de uma autorização de um pai ou responsável autorizando a permanência após este horário.

Esta é uma competição de 24 horas e portanto atente-se a isso. Caso não possa ficar as 24 horas, não há necessidade, preze pela sua saúde e bem-estar mental.

REGISTRATION
The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements, without fulfilling these requirements, the registration will not be accepted:
​
Register through the WCA website, pay in advance and send proof to the organizer via email (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) indicating the participant's full name. More details about the payment below;
​
Wait for your registration to be approved online. In the case of not participating and having already paid the registration, no money will be returned. 
There will be a limit of 40 competitors.
For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com)

To underage competitors that will stay alone during the night period, it will be requested an express authorization of a parent or guardian authorizing the competitor's participation during said period.

This is a 24 hour competition, therefore, be attentive to that. In case you're not able to stay the 24 hours, there is no need to, value your health and mental well-being.

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdXB0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--12c29642a2fc1a7776803f30970bc62ffd4c6ceb/CuceiOpen_2%20(1).png)
10 años despues de la primera competencia en las instalaciones de CUCEI, **¡volvemos con el CUCEI Open 2024!**
Esta es la 11va competencia oficial en el estado de Jalisco, en la cual buscamos conmemorar un poco sobre la historia del speedcubing en las tierras del tequila. Te invitamos a que disfrutes de las categorías favoritas de los speedcubers jalisciences en el 10mo aniversario de una de las competencias más importantes de Guadalajara. 

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/#2a) antes de la competencia.

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

Será um prazer recebê-los.

**Dicas:**
- Chegue ao local da competição pelo menos **30 minutos** antes de **modalidade que participará**;
- O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado;
- Você é responsável pelo seu cubo e seus pertences, cuide deles. Não nos responsabilizamos por perda de cubos mágicos e outros pertences durante a competição;
- Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar para a equipe de organização e delegados.

Mesmo que a nossa competição seja formada por alguns competidores experientes, sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas.
Procure se divertir bastante!

### ENGLISH

Welcome to **Rio Cubolympics 2024**!
It will be a pleasure to welcome you.

**Tips:**
- Arrive at the competition location at least **30 minutes** before **the category you will participate in**;
- The cube you will compete with must be in good condition;
- You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of cubes and other belongings during the competition;
- If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organization team and delegates.

Even though our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, we will always have room for new cubers.
Have a lot of fun!

items.name: Katerini Beach Open 2024
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbFZ1IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--832ba1051dbfb958a61c53d310fdebb0b82e9442/image.png)
Συνεχίζουμε τη συναρπαστική σειρά των διαγωνισμών για το 2024 με το 'Katerini Beach Open 2024', τον 4ο διαγωνισμό της χρονιάς. Αυτή τη φορά πηγαίνουμε βόρεια, στην ξακουστή παραλία της Κατερίνης, δίπλα στο κύμα! Στο συνεδριακό κέντρο του ξενοδοχείου Mediterranean Village θα συναντηθούμε με την φιλοδοξία να πραγματοποιηθεί ένα από τα μεγαλύτερα αν όχι το μεγαλύτερο έως τώρα OPEN της Ελλάδας! Σε ένα μοναδικό Σαββατοκύριακο, με άρωμα από το επερχόμενο ελληνικό καλοκαίρι, όλοι οι συμμετέχοντες θα απολαύσουν το πάθος τους για το cubing σε έναν ιδανικό προορισμό. 

Πάρτε τους κύβους σας (και τα μαγιό σας) και ελάτε να γιορτάσουμε μαζί την αγάπη για το cubing σε ένα αμιγώς ελληνικό τοπίο!

Παρακαλούμε διαβάστε όλες τις καρτέλες για να βρείτε τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. 

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)

[Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI)

We continue the exciting series of competitions for 2024 with the 'Katerini Beach Open 2024', the 4th competition of the year. This time we go north, to the famous beach of Katerini, by the sea! In the conference center of the Mediterranean Village hotel & SPA we will meet again with the ambition to hold one of the biggest, if not the biggest, OPEN in Greece! In a unique weekend, with the aroma of the upcoming Greek summer, all participants will enjoy their passion for cubing in an ideal destination. 

Grab your cubes (and your swimsuits) and come celebrate the love of cubing together in a purely Greek landscape!

Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information.

Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs.
Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.name: Ekibastuz Open 2024
items.information:
**Русский**
​
Ekibastuz Open 2024 - это открытый чемпионат в городе Экибастуз.
Базовый взнос с возможностью участия в любом количестве дисциплин составляет 3000 тенге. При регистрации на 1 любую дисциплину регистрационный взнос составит 1000 тенге.
Данные сореванования организованы командами ОДК "Спидкубер" и QBERS.
​
**Қазақша**
​
Ekibastuz Open 2024 - бұл Екібастұз қаласындағы ашық чемпионат.
Пәндердің кез келген санына қатысу ақысы - 3000 теңге. Кез келген бір пәнге қатысу ақысы - 1000 теңге.
Осы жарыс ОДК "Спидкубер" және QBERS құрамаларымен ұйымдастырылады.
​
**English**
​
Ekibastuz Open 2024 is a competition in the city of Ekibastuz.
The base registration fee for any number of events is 3000 tenge. If you're participating in 1 event only, the registration fee is 1000 tenge. 
This competition is organized by ODK "Speedcuber" and QBERS teams.

REGISTRO
La participación en este torneo requiere de la comprensión de los siguientes requisitos:

Esperar a que el registro electrónico sea aceptado.

Registration fee is $20.000 COP until february 29th, $25.000 COP until april 30th, $35.000 COP until may 11th, $45.000 COP in situ.

items.name: Swedish Championship 2024
items.information:
Välkomna till Svenska Mästerskapen 2024! 

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. 

Det blir i år en 3-dagarstävling med alla WCA-grenar utom en, 3x3x3 FMC. Den Svenska Mästaren i den grenen kommer krönas på den separata tävlingen [Swedish FMC Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2024).

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, priser och titeln Svensk Mästare.

-----

Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2024!

Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes.

This year there will be a 3-day competition with all WCA events but one, 3x3x3 FMC. The Swedish Champion in this event will be crowned at the separate competition [Swedish FMC Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2024).

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, but only participants representing Sweden can win medals, prizes and the title of Swedish Champion.

items.name: Örebro Side Events 2024
items.information:
Välkomna till den första tävlingen någonsin i Örebro!

Notera att varken 3x3 eller de andra mest populära grenarna hålls på denna tävling. Självklart är ändå alla varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet.

Detta är också en utmärkt möjlighet att delta på [FMC-SM](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2024), som hålls dagen efter och det finns möjlighet att tävla i Örebro. Däremot är platserna begränsade till sju deltagare, så anmäl dig snarast om du är sugen!

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

-----

Welcome to the first competition ever in Örebro!

Please note that neither 3x3 nor the other most popular events will be held at this competition. Regardless, everyone is of course welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience.

This is also an excellent opportunity to participate in the [Swedish FMC Championship](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2024) which is held the day after, and it's possible to compete in Örebro. There is however a 7-person limit, so make sure to grab a spot soon if you're interested!

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

[![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.information:
[CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce a new Cape Town competition for 2024. This comp will focus on the original cube, the **3x3x3**, and the varying ways to solve it - with **two hands, one-handed, blindfolded**, and in the **fewest moves**; and we will round out the events with some **2x2, 4x4,** and **Megaminx**. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make payment by buying a ticket. Please see **Registration Requirements** below."

### SPECTATORS

Competitors are welcome to bring 2 spectators with them. Please let us know if you need to accommodate more spectators.

### VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). 

### SPONSORSHIP
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbU10IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--03db2d12875f7b21e073b29649b48a5bc813b0e2/image.png)
A big thanks to [Speedcubes](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/) who are sponsoring vouchers as a part of the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to try out and buy the different speedcubes they have on offer.

### LUCKY DRAW

During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store.

#### About CubingZA

CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. In 2024, we are anticipating being able to host one competition every season in each of the cities of Cape Town, Johannesburg, and Durban, as well as other regular events in Pretoria, Bloemfontein, Limpopo, and more!

If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to bring competitive speedcubing to the country, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact).

## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Trondheim Spring 2024! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.

### On The Spot Registreringer
Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 50kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSpring2024/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen.

### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSpring2024#40829-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors).


---

## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to Trondheim Spring 2024! The competition is open to all who wish to compete.

### On The Spot Registration
Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 50 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSpring2024/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot.

### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSpring2024#40829-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

#Please check the schedule to find possible time slots.  Please indicate in the registration comments what timeslot you would prefer to compete in.
#Competitors may register for 3x3 and up to one of the following events: 2x2, Skewb, Pyraminx, Megaminx, Clock, or Square-1.  Competitors may not register for more than two events, and if they register for two events, one of them must be 3x3.

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz.

**ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades.
**ATENÇÃO:** Devido ao tamanho do local da competição, apenas um acompanhante será permitido por competidor. Façamos a competição ser possível para todos os competidores!

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge.

**ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events.
**ATTENTION:** Due to the size of the competition's venue, only one guest will be allowed per competitor. Please do not bring more guests than the allowed quantity, let's make the competition possible for all competitors!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc0JpIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--41c939ff9d04a9ee030bab08d4426f317f1ff9ec/image.png)

Το τρίτο μέρος της σειράς διαγωνισμών μας οδηγεί ξανά σε μια μοναδική τοποθεσία: τα escape rooms Rubicon! Εδώ, οι συμμετέχοντες θα αντιμετωπίσουν τα πιο περίεργα παζλ της σειράς. Μια απόλυτη δοκιμασία του μυαλού και της δημιουργικότητας, όπου η ευφυΐα και η επινοητικότητα θα είναι τα κλειδιά για την επιτυχία. Ετοιμαστείτε για έναν διαγωνισμό διαφορετικό από τους άλλους και ανακαλύψτε τις δυνατότητές σας σε έναν κόσμο γεμάτο παζλ!

Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. 

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)

[Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI)

The third part of the series of competitions takes us again to a unique location: the Rubicon escape rooms! Here, participants will face the most unusual and original puzzles. It's an ultimate test of the mind and creativity, where intelligence and inventiveness are the keys to success. Get ready for a competition unlike any other and discover your potential in a world filled with puzzles!

Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information.

Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs.
Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

**INFORMATION**
CubingZA is excited to announce Deep South Solving 2024! This competition is mainly focused on the less popular events, from bigger NxNs like 5x5, 6x6 and 7x7, to side events like megaminx and clock, and even blind events!
Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and make payment by buying a ticket. Please see Registration Requirements below.

**MYSTERY PRIZES**
We will include some fun prizes at this competition and there will be some interesting prizes to claim!

**SPECTATORS**
Competitors are welcome to bring 1 spectator with them. Please let us know if you need to accommodate more spectators.

**VOLUNTEERING**
Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at this video.
Note: this competition has a much smaller competitor limit, meaning most rounds will not need runners as the majority of the rounds will be done with fixed seating.

All competitors should read the Competitor Responsibilities tab before registering

**How to Change/Cancel Your Registration**

Competitors can modify their registration through the Register tab.

Competitors can also change or cancel by emailing the organization team with the following information:
1. Intent to change/cancel registration
2. Desired changes to registration
3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor.

In the event that a competitor cancels their registration, they will only receive a 75% refund.

The deadline to change/cancel your registration is March 30th, 2023 at 5:00 PM Mountain Time.

**Waitlist Procedure**

If registration fills up, we will place competitors on a waitlist. In the event a competitor drops from the competition, competitors will be accepted from the waitlist in the order we receive payment. Competitors can be accepted from the waitlist until March 30th, 2023 at 5:00 PM Mountain Time. You will receive a full refund if you are still on the waitlist by then.

# ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaGxIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e1a87d9563999f890af638f98836b63b2aac90c5/6u.png) Español 

Hay un límite de 40 competidores para el registro.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AltavistaBigOpen2024#39507-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AltavistaBigOpen2024#39508-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación de la categoría, de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del Reglamento de la WCA.
* Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia.

Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA.

***

¡Bienvenidos al Mololoa Open 2024, la **segunda competencia oficial** en el hermoso estado de **Nayarit**!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic los días sábado 23 y domingo 24 de marzo de 2024.

Welcome to Mololoa Open 2024, the **second official competition** in the beautiful state of **Nayarit**! This exciting and high-speed event will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, March 23, and Sunday, March 24, 2024.

Mololoa Open 2024 will bring together cubers from across the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events. items.information:
This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. The registration process will prioritize new competitors for registration, and returning competitors will be accepted after. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

**New competitors registration will be accepted based on the following:**
* The first 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. 
* If greater than 25% of new competitors register, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
* If less than 25% of new competitors register before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

**Returning competitors may still register at any point during the registration period, but their registration will be accepted based on the following:**

* The first 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. 
* If 25% of spots are filled by new competitors, returning competitors will then be accepted on a first come, first serve basis.
* If 25% of spots are not filled by new competitors by registration close two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

---

As the month of March is WCA Newcomer Month, 25% of the competitor limit will be reserved for first-time competitors or competitors who's first competition is in 2024. More information can be found on the [WCA Newcomer Month tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWMegacomp2024#36408-wca-newcomer-month).

- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWMegacomp2024#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. 

Day 1 Events: 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, Clock, Pyraminx

Day 2 Events: 3x3x3 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Megaminx, Square-1

* Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.

**Competition Day Timing**
- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
- Lunch will end at the scheduled time. 
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. 
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

#### **How to Withdraw/Alter Registration**
Registered competitors withdraw/alter their registration by emailing the organisation team (unrcubing@gmail.com) the following:
1. Statement of intent to withdraw/alter registration.
2. Changes to registration (if appplicable).
3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor.

#### **Check-In**
Competitors will receive a name tag.

#### **Staff Member Registration**
Competition staff members are hand-selected by the organisation team and will be offered a refunded registration fee in exchange for their service to the cubing community for the entire duration of the competition.

items.name: Beginner Cubing Delmenhorst 2024
items.information:
**English**

We are looking forward to welcome you at the first competition in Delmenhorst and the third one in Lower Saxony!

**This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024.** The registration process will reserve 35% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

**Registrations will be accepted based on the following:**
* 35 spots (35% of spots) are initially reserved for new competitors.
* 65 spots (65% of spots) are initially available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
* If more than 35 new competitors register before 65 spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
* If the 35 spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

**Deutsch**

Wir freuen uns euch auf der ersten Competition in Delmenhorst und der dritten in Niedersachsen begrüßen zu dürfen!

**Dieser Wettbewerb ist Teil des offiziellen WCA Newcomer Month 2024.** Bei der Anmeldung werden 35% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmer reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmer gelten Teilnehmer ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2024. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmer haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2023 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmer müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt.

**Anmeldungen werden nach folgenden Kriterien angenommen:**
* 35 Plätze (35% der Plätze) sind zunächst für neue Teilnehmer reserviert.
* 65 Plätze (65% der Plätze) sind zunächst für wiederkehrende Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" verfügbar.
* Wenn sich mehr als 35 neue Teilnehmer anmelden, bevor die 65 Plätze von den wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern besetzt sind, werden alle weiteren neuen Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" zusammen mit den wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern zugelassen.
* Wenn die 35 für neue Teilnehmer reservierten Plätze zwei Wochen vor dem Wettbewerb nicht durch neue Teilnehmer besetzt sind, werden die verbleibenden Plätze bis zum Teilnehmerlimit den bereits registrierten wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern zugewiesen.

items.information:
###Português

O Schoolmark Open está de volta! Com algumas mudanças e surpresas, porém com a mesma atmosfera que tornou as primeiras edições tão boas!
Algumas informações importantes:
*  É imprescindível entender as regras, conforme **[Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)**
*  A competição é aberta a qualquer pessoa que deseje participar, indepentende de idade, nacionalidade, ou velocidade de resolução.
*  Além disso, a competição também é aberta a acompanhantes e espectadores.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

**Atenção**: Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem **certeza que irá participar.**
Em caso de desistência, por favor **entrar em contato com a organização ([felipeqcardim@gmail.com](mailto:felipeqcardim@gmail.com))**
As inscrições deverão ser pagas **via Stripe** na aba de **Inscrever.**


###English

Schoolmark Open is back! With a few changes and surprises, but with the same atmosphere that made the first editions so great!
Some important information:
* It's essential to understand the rules, as in the **[WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)**
* The competition is open to any person that wants to participate, independent of age, nationality, or solving speed.
* Besides that, the competition is also open to guests and spectators.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said in WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.information:
##### *English version is below*

#### **Deutsch:**

Nach einem erfolgreichem Fasching Turnier im letzten Jahr, dürfen wir auch dieses Jahr wieder Vienna Fasching 2024 als offizelles WCA Turnier ankündigen.

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von David Dinh, Jeremia Neuhold, Lucas Höglinger und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar und Pranjal Khan. Diesmal findet die Competition im Jugendgästehaus Brigittenau statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen!

Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen.


Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

-----

#### **English:**

After a successful Fasching Competition last year, we are once again happy to announce Vienna Fasching 2024 as an official WCA Competition.

The speedcubing competition is organised by David Dinh, Jeremia Neuhold, Lucas Höglinger and delegated by Viktor Kalmar and Pranjal Khan. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.information:
(BR) **Bem-vindos à segunda competição oficial de Morro Reuter!**
Enquanto a maioria das pessoas viaja às praias no verão, a ideia de trazer a população cubista para um lugar calmo e tranquilo na Serra Gaúcha deu origem ao Morro Reuter em Colônia 2024!

A oferta dessa competição é para aproveitar o período de férias longe do stress e tumulto das praias e grandes centros urbanos, trazendo desafios em Gincana interativa, com atividades que desenvolvam o trabalho em equipes e a melhor interação entre os competidores, especialmente crianças do Sul do Brasil.

Nos vemos lá!


(EN) **Welcome to the second official competition in Morro Reuter!**
While most people travel to the beach during the summer, the idea of bringing the speedcubing community to a quiet and peaceful place in tthe Gaucho highlands gave birth to *Morro Reuter em Colônia 2024*!

The proposition of this competition is to take advantage of the holiday season, far from the stress and chaos of the beaches and great urban centres, bringing challenges in an interactive contest, with activities that develop teamwork and the best interaction among the competitors, especially the children from Southern Brazil.

See you there!

items.name: Barely Awake Boulder 2024
items.information:
We are excited to welcome competitors back to Boulder for the first time since 2016, and for the second ever 24+ hour competition held in North America!

Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important!

This competition has a 150 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition!
Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.

Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, this video will provide you with most of the information you need. https://youtu.be/dPL3eV-A0ww
If this is your first competition, please be present 15 minutes before the competitor tutorial at 11:00 AM, which means you should plan to arrive at 10:45 AM.

If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (2024-01-20 00:00 UTC)

items.name: Cubestuff Challenge Q1 2024
items.information:
## SPECTATORS

Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them.

## VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). 


## SPONSORSHIP

A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za/) who are sponsoring the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer.

## VENUE HEAT 
This is an indoor venue with fans, but no aircon. It might get quite warm if we have a hot weekend. Please be aware of this, bring enough water, and make any preparations needed.

#### About CubingZA

Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

items.name: DeNxNver 2024
items.information:
Welcome back for a second reindition of DeNxNver! This is a winter competition put on by Colorado Cubers.

All competitors should read the Competitor Responsibilities tab before registering
 
**How to Change/Cancel Your Registration**

Competitors can modify their registration through the Register tab.

Competitors can also change or cancel by emailing the organization team with the following information:
1. Intent to change/cancel registration
2. Desired changes to registration
3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor.

In the event that a competitor cancels their registration, they will only receive a 75% refund.

The deadline to change/cancel your registration is January 12th, 2023, 5:00 PM Mountain Time.

**Waitlist Procedure**

If registration fills up, we will place competitors on a waitlist. In the event a competitor drops from the competition, competitors will be accepted from the waitlist in the order we receive payment. Competitors can be accepted from the waitlist until January 12th at 5:00 PM MST. You will receive a full refund if you are still on the waitlist by then.

A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

This competition is in a series with [Waterloo Favourites Autumn 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WaterlooFavouritesAutumn2023). items.information:
This is the 10th WCA competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
The competition is open to all persons from all countries.

**Note**: there is a maximum limit of ten competitors in the 3x3x3 multiblind event, on a first-come, first-served basis. If you register for multiblind after the ten slots have been filled you will be placed on a waiting list in case anybody deletes their registration later.

There will be certificates and medals for all competitors in top 3 of an event.

================

Ovo je 10. WCA takmičenje u Bosni i Hercegovini.
Takmičenje je otvoreno za sve osobe iz svih zemalja.

**Napomena**: može biti maksimalno deset takmičara u 3x3x3 multiblind disciplini, po principu „prvi dođe, prvi uslužen“. Ako se registruje za multiblind nakon što je deset mjesta popunjeno, bit ćete stavljeni na listu čekanja, i vraćeni sa iste u slučaju da neko kasnije izbriše svoju registraciju.

Za sve takmičare u prva 3 mjesta biće dodeljeni sertifikati i medalje.

# Bienvenidos al Mexican Championship 2023

¡Bienvenidos a la página oficial del **Mexican Championship 2023**, el campeonato de speedcubing más grande de México! Estamos emocionados de recibir a todos los competidores y entusiastas del speedcubing en este gran evento.


# Programa del Evento

El campeonato incluirá una serie de emocionantes competencias y actividades para participantes de todos los niveles. Desde los principiantes hasta los cuberos experimentados, habrá algo para todos. ¡Prepárate para desafiar tus habilidades y conocer a otros amantes del cubo!

Asegúrate de revisar las reglas y reglamentos oficiales de la WCA antes del campeonato. Esto te ayudará a estar preparado y a asegurarte de que tus intentos sean válidos. ¡Que empiece la diversión y que gane el mejor!

# Welcome to the Mexican Championship 2023

Welcome to the official website of the Mexican Championship 2023, the largest speedcubing championship in Mexico! We are excited to welcome all competitors and speedcubing enthusiasts to this grand event.

# Event Schedule
The championship will feature a series of exciting competitions and activities for participants of all levels. From beginners to experienced cubers, there will be something for everyone. Get ready to challenge your skills and meet other cube lovers!

# Rules and Regulations
Make sure to review the official WCA rules and regulations before the championship. This will help you be prepared and ensure that your attempts are valid. You can find the rules in the official [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Let the fun begin and may the best cuber win!

A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.information:
[CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the final Cape Town competition for 2023. This competition will have a **strong focus on 3x3**, with four rounds! 2x2 also makes a return with two rounds, and we are holding a handful of other events that have not featured in Cape Town for some time, namely 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, Megaminx, 3x3 Blindfolded, and 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded!

### SPECTATORS

Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them.

### VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). 

### SPONSORSHIP
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbU10IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--03db2d12875f7b21e073b29649b48a5bc813b0e2/image.png)
A big thanks to [Speedcubes](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/) who are sponsoring vouchers as a part of the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to try out and buy the different speedcubes they have on offer.

### LUCKY DRAW

During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store.

#### About CubingZA

Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdkpWIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d21635fc0f5cbe802272c9c1169d1a241d81b7bf/394771855_661572126079922_8082539372510634594_n.jpg)
Έφτασε επιτέλους η στιγμή που περίμενε τόσα χρόνια όλη η Ελληνική Speedcubing Κοινότητα! 
Το 2023 βάλαμε στόχο και πετύχαμε να απογειώσουμε το Cubing στην Ελλάδα! 
Και τώρα να ‘μαστε, μετά από τη σειρά των τεσσάρων "Road to Nationals" Opens μέσα στο 2023 σε τέσσερα διαφορετικά σημεία της χώρας, σε κλίμα γιορτινό και με όλες τις τιμές που πρέπει, να διοργανώνουμε τα πρώτα GREEK NATIONALS στο Speedcubing! 
Mε μεγάλη χαρά σας καλούμε, μικρούς και μεγάλους, Cubers και Θεατές στη γιορτή του Cubing, τη δική μας γιορτή, για να περάσουμε τρεις υπέροχες μέρες!

Παρακαλούμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες σχετικά με το εθνικό πρωτάθλημα του 2023. 

Σημαντική Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στη WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών Stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε ετοιμασμένοι:

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)

[Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI)


The moment the entire Greek Speedcubing Community has been waiting for so many years has finally arrived!
In 2023 we set a goal and succeeded in boosting Cubing in Greece!
And now, after a series of four "Road to Nationals Opens" in four different locations of the country, in a festive atmosphere and with all due honors befitting the occasion, here we stand organizing the first GREEK NATIONAL CHAMPIONSHIP in Speedcubing!
It is with great pleasure that we invite you, young and old, Cubers and Spectators to the celebration of Cubing, to our celebration, to spend three beautiful days!

# 🇺🇾
Límite de competidores: 40.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoenLlamas2023#35967-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoenLlamas2023#35968-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor descalificandolo de la ronda en cuestión, de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.
* Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia.

Ante cualquier duda, consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA.

# 🇬🇧
Competitor limit: 40.

* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoenLlamas2023#35967-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoenLlamas2023#35968-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Competitors must bring their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, as per regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.
* It is important to read all the information available in the competition's website.

Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

items.information:
**(Português) Brasileiro**
É com grande alegria que anunciamos o retorno do Capivara!

A partir desse ano, pretendemos trabalhar com doações para fins filantrópicos, assim, além de nos divertirmos, também ajudamos a fazer um mundo melhor. Estamos trabalhando em conjunto com o [LEO e Lions](https://www.lionsclubs.org/) para arrecadar brinquedos e alimentos para crianças carentes, então todo o lucro da competição será revertido para essa campanha. Além disso, se você quiser fazer uma doação no dia, também será muito bem-vinda.

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=hfp2rKaN8jHPI_RL).

É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, que podem ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/).

Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Feminino' e 'Iniciante', que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'.

**English**
It is in great excitement that we announce the return of Capivara!

From this year on, we intend to work with donations for philanthropic purposes, therefore, in addition to having fun, we can also help make a better world. We are working together with [LEO and Lions](https://www.lionsclubs.org/) to collect toys and food to children in need, so all profit from the competition will be directed to that campaign. Besides that, if you would like to give a donation on the spot, it will also be very welcome.

Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://youtu.be/dZQiw5v8Bm0?si=6Yf5Zun_nlTfECTy).

It is very important that you know the regulations, which may be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Female' and 'Beginner', which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

venue.name: Mimosa Mall

items.information:
[CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the Mimosa Mall Master Cubers 2023 speedcubing competition! This competition will focus on a variety of shorter, popular events, several of which have never been held in Bloemfontein before. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make an EFT payment to confirm your entry. Please see **Registration Requirements** below for the banking details and when registration opens.

### Masters and Challengers

This competition will recognise the performance of both established cubers and relatively new competitors - if you have never been to a competition before, or come from the Free State and your only other competition you have attended was Mimosa Mall Master Cubers 2022 (last year's competition), then you qualify as a Challenger. All Challengers will be able to qualify for their own prizes and podium places. Otherwise, if you have attended at least 2 competitions before, you are a Master Cuber and will be competing against some of the best in the country for the top prizes!

### All New Competitors

If this is your first time competing, or the first time your child or ward is competing, please ensure to bring with ID (card, book, passport, birth certificate) so that we can verify that the name is spelled correctly, the Date of Birth is correct, and the Nationality is correct.
Please also ensure you have all the puzzles you need to compete - we do not supply puzzles for competitors. You are welcome to ask other competitors if you can borrow their puzzle for a certain event, but there is no guarantee. If you need a puzzle before the competition, check out www.speedcubes.co.za, www.cubeco.co.za, or https://cubestuff.co.za/ to order your puzzles before the comp.

### Spectators

As this is a public venue in a shopping mall, any spectators can attend for free. Please be aware that there will be arranged seating specifically for parents and guardians of competitors, but this will be limited.

### Volunteering

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). 

### Sponsorship

Massive thanks to Mimosa Mall for sponsoring this competition. As part of the sponsorship, they are providing the venue free of charge, as well as all of the competition sound/video equipment we will need and assisting with setup, advertising, and of course, providing a very generous amount of prize money for the winners!

### Lucky Draw

During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Saturday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store.

#### About CubingZA

Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdkJSIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2ec91b0578bf841894ad746e0643e0b8635a99e3/logo_WCM.png)

#### Warsaw Cube Masters powraca!

Zapraszamy do Warszawy zarówno starych wyjadaczy jak i nowych zawodników aby razem spędzić czas w atmosferze kostkowego święta. Poprzednia edycja zaowocowała rekordem świata w wykonaniu Macieja Czapiewskiego, mamy więc nadzieję, że i tym razem nie zabraknie znakomitych wyników i rekordów. Liczymy, że uda się nam spędzić miło czas zacieśniając stare przyjaźnie i zawiązując nowe.

Zachęcamy do przejrzenia wszystkich zakładek, znajdują się tam naprawdę przydatne informacje, a jeżeli nie wyczerpały one pytań, do kontaktu z nami za pomocą formularza dostępnego pod przyciskiem "Kontakt".

---

#### Warsaw Cube Masters returns!
We invite both old timers and new competitors to Warsaw to spend time in atmosphere of cubing festivity. Previous edition resulted in spectacular world record by Maciej Czapiewski so we hope that this time there will be a lot of great results and records as well. We also hope to nurture old cubing friendships and create some new while spending good time at the competition.

Please visit all tabs, you will be able to find there very useful informations, and if they will not answer all of your questions don't hesitate to contact us via form available under "Contact" button.

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

## Nearby Competitions

This competition features "side events" and will not have the standard 3x3x3 Cube as an event. Please consider registering for [a different competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada&state=present&show_registration_status=on) if this one isn't for you.

## Mailing List

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information:
##### 🇧🇷
O **Pé Vermelho 2023** é um campeonato **aberto** e **beneficente**. Aqui estão algumas instruções e lembretes para quem pretende participar:

* Todas as informações sobre inscrição no evento podem ser encontradas na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelho2023/register).
* As inscrições vão até o dia **20/10/2023**, ou até que o **limite de 50 competidores** seja atingido. Após essa data, só será possível a inscrição no dia do campeonato, caso haja vagas remanescentes.
* Chegue ao local da competição, com seu cubo em mãos, no mínimo 30 minutos antes do horário de qualquer modalidade que você participará.
* É necessário que todos os participantes leiam o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição.
* O cubo com o qual você vai competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele. Caso contrário, o cubo pode não ser aceito para a competição.
* Caso seja seu primeiro campeonato, assista [este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE).
* Não há idade mínima ou máxima para participação, mas competidores menores de 18 anos só podem participar com a presença de um responsável legal.
* Todos os competidores devem apresentar documento válido com foto no credenciamento!
* Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. Mande seus questionamentos para a [organização](diego.quintanilha@hotmail.com) e faremos o melhor possível para ajudar. Sempre há espaço para novos competidores!
* Divirta-se!

---

##### 🇺🇸
**Pé Vermelho 2023** is an **open charity** competition. Here are some instructions and reminders for those who wish to participate:

* All information regarding registration can be found in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelho2023/register) tab.
* Registration closes on **10/20/2023**, or whenever the **limit of 50 competitors** is reached. After that, it will only be possible to register for the 3x3x3 Cube event, in the day of the competition, if there are still vacancies.
* Be present at the competition venue, in possession of your cube, at least 30 minutes earlier for any event you are participating.
* All participants must read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.
* The cube with which you will compete must be in good condition, so take good care of it. Otherwise, your cube may not be approved for the competition.
* If this is your first competition, watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE).
* There is no minimum or maximum age for participation, but underage competitors can only participate with the presence of a legal guardian.
* All competitors must present a valid document at the check-in.
* If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. You can e-mail your questions to the [organization](diego.quintanilha@hotmail.com), and we will do our best to help you. There is always room for new speedcubers!
* Have fun!

---

items.information:
NZ North Island Championship 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

In addition, NZ North Island Championship 2023 is the last regional championship of 2023 in the lead up to Nationals in December.

## Pickering Fall 2023 Series

This competition is in a series with [Pickering Fall B 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PickeringFallB2023). You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for both of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.***

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted and registration fees will not be transferred across competitions. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Mailing List

We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Rubik's UK Championship 2023
items.information:
## Welcome to Rubik's UK Championship 2023!
### This year's UK National Championship!

#### Please read ALL tabs before registering as there is lots of information which will be new to you, even if you are an experienced competitor.

##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Guests, Spectators, and Media](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2023#32058-guests-spectators-and-media) tab.

**Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Rubik's UK Championship 2023, you'll receive a Rubik's UK Championship 2023 t-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your t-shirt size.**

**Guests:** Guests will **only** be permitted to attend by paying a **£5** fee **at the competition**. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** The fee must be paid at the competition and cannot be prepaid beforehand. The guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only; the fee must be paid at the competition. We accept cash or card payments.

**Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2023#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by *9th October 2023*, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. There are no qualifications in 3x3, 2x2, Pyraminx, or Skewb, so **newcomers will be able to compete in these events only**.

**Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round, we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3 - 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors.

**Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionshipFMC2023). The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Rubik's UK Championship 2023.

**Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.
